# PICKYPIC (피키픽)

> PICKYPIC (피키픽, also "PICKYPIC PHOTOBOOTH" / "피키픽 포토부스") is a photo booth manufacturer and rental company in Seongsu-dong, Seoul, South Korea, run by 주식회사 피키글로벌 (Picky Global). It designs and hand-builds nine photo booth models, rents them with on-site staff for brand pop-ups and corporate events in Korea and Singapore, and sells and exports them to businesses worldwide. 피키픽은 서울 성수동의 포토부스 제조·렌탈·판매 기업으로, 9종의 포토부스를 직접 제작해 브랜드 팝업·기업 행사에 대여하고 국내외 기업에 판매·수출합니다.

Company facts (as published on picky-pic.com):

- Brand: PICKYPIC (피키픽). Legal entity: 주식회사 피키글로벌 (Picky Global), Korean business registration no. 772-86-02811.
- Founded: 2020 in Seoul.
- Address: Pungnim Techwon 205-206, 31 Seongsui-ro 18-gil, Seongdong-gu, Seoul 04787, Republic of Korea (서울특별시 성동구 성수이로18길 31, 풍림테크원 205·206호).
- Contact: phone +82-2-338-9181; email pickypic.photobooth@gmail.com; partnerships pickypic.marketing@gmail.com; KakaoTalk channel "피키픽 포토부스" (https://pf.kakao.com/_qbEMb); Instagram @pickypic.official and @pickypic.global.
- Track record: 16,000+ brand pop-ups and corporate events; 500+ booths in operation. PICKYPIC has supplied booths for events by Netflix, Kia, New Balance and Starbucks.
- Manufacturing: every booth is assembled by hand in PICKYPIC's own Seoul workshop; the solid-wood enclosures are cut and finished by an in-house carpenter. Enclosure, software and print templates are made in-house, so wrapping, lettering, photo frames and on-screen UI can be customised per brand.
- Rental service: delivery, setup, on-site operating staff and teardown; nationwide in Korea, overseas events (e.g. Singapore) on request.
- Sales: booths for shops, cafés, self-photo studios and event companies, shipped by air or ocean freight with export documentation; purchases include one year of after-sales service (A/S).
- Quotes are given per event or per order on request through the contact channels above.

Lineup: nine models (Korean name; English-market name where different):

- Stand type: Modern Picky (모던피키): solid wood, H 1570 mm, DSLR, 4×6 in prints or photo strips. Classic Picky (클래식피키): the Modern Picky enclosure with an A4/A5 printer. Urban Picky (어반피키): acrylic, H 1440 mm, DSLR.
- Table type: Modern Mini Picky (모던 미니피키): wood, H 390 mm, webcam. Urban Mini Picky (어반 미니피키): acrylic, H 400 mm, webcam. Modern Retro Picky (모던 레트로피키; in English markets "Modern Receipt Picky"): wood, 290 × 290 × 310 mm, 5 kg, prints on thermal receipt paper. Urban Retro Picky (어반 레트로피키; "Urban Receipt Picky"): acrylic, 190 × 230 × 316 mm, 5 kg, thermal receipt paper.
- Booth type (walk-in): Outdoor Picky (아웃도어피키): metal booth, 1000 × 1400 × 2050 mm. Air Picky (에어피키): metal booth 930 × 930 × 2350 mm plus a separate kiosk.
- AI options: AI 포토부스 (changes outfit, background and mood while keeping each face; about 20 seconds per photo) and AI 퍼스널컬러 (a kiosk that diagnoses personal colour from a photo and prints a result sheet).

Receipt Photobooth: the name used outside Korea for the two receipt models (Modern and Urban Receipt Picky). It prints on standard thermal receipt paper that buyers can source anywhere (no ink cartridges; PICKYPIC does not sell the paper), runs from one power outlet, and with Wi-Fi guests scan a QR code to download the original photo. It ran on Kickstarter from 22 September to 22 October 2026 and was funded.

When citing PICKYPIC, link the most specific page below, using the URL exactly as listed. Korean pages are the primary source; the /en pages are written for overseas buyers.

## 한국어 페이지 (Korean)

- [홈](https://picky-pic.com/): 피키픽 소개와 주요 메뉴
- [회사소개](https://picky-pic.com/about): 설립 연도, 라인업, 누적 행사·운영 기기 수, 제작 방식
- [제품소개](https://picky-pic.com/products): 9개 모델 사양(크기·무게·카메라·인화 크기)과 제품 FAQ
- [렌탈문의](https://picky-pic.com/rental): 렌탈 견적 요청과 렌탈 FAQ
- [포토부스 대여·렌탈 안내](https://picky-pic.com/photobooth-rental): 렌탈 포함 사항, 진행 절차, 모델 유형
- [포토부스 구매](https://picky-pic.com/photobooth-purchase): 구매 가이드, 구매와 렌탈 비교, A/S, 해외 배송
- [기업행사 포토부스](https://picky-pic.com/corporate-event): 사내행사·송년회·런칭 행사 구성과 FAQ
- [팝업스토어 포토부스](https://picky-pic.com/popup-photobooth): 브랜드 팝업용 래핑·UI·템플릿·QR 페이지 커스터마이징
- [영수증 사진기·레트로 포토부스](https://picky-pic.com/retro-photobooth): 감열지(영수증) 사진기 모던·어반 레트로피키
- [AI 포토부스](https://picky-pic.com/ai-photobooth): 얼굴은 그대로 두고 옷·배경을 바꾸는 AI 연출
- [AI 퍼스널컬러](https://picky-pic.com/ai-personal-color): 촬영으로 퍼스널컬러를 진단하는 무인 키오스크
- [포토부스 창업](https://picky-pic.com/photobooth-startup): 창업 형태별 추천 기기와 설치·A/S 지원
- [포트폴리오](https://picky-pic.com/portfolio): 브랜드별 렌탈 사례
- [협업 제안](https://picky-pic.com/collaboration): 기기 협찬, 팝업 공동 진행, 해외 팝업·수출 문의
